notable_absence.finding: The measured Capella twin (cloud/search/customize-index.json, similarity 0.45) documents a dedicated Scoring Model feature (search:scoring-model, tf-idf vs bm25, gated at version:server-8-0 AND capella:advanced-mode) directly on its equivalent page. This server/ 8.0 page's feature table has no Scoring Model row or section at all - the concept is not mentioned here. This is very likely an organizational difference rather than a real feature gap (search-index-architecture.md, elsewhere in this same batch, links scoring explanation to run-searches.md#scoring instead), but it means the two 'Customize a Search Index' pages, despite sharing a title and hub role, do not cover the same feature set - see cross_product_finding.

cross_component_finding: None found beyond what the Capella twin already established.
cross_product_finding: This is the measured 0.45-similarity twin of cloud/search/customize-index.json, and the low score reflects real, structural divergence, confirmed here: (1) the UI-affordance gating mechanism is different in shape - Capella's page gates features behind an in-place Advanced Mode toggle within one editor (capella:advanced-mode), while this server/ page gates the identical class of features (custom document filters, custom analyzer components) behind using an entirely separate editor, the standard editor (search:create-search-index-ui), reusing the SAME requiresUiMode predicate but with a structurally different object - a UI-mode-toggle vs a whole-separate-editor-choice are two different mechanisms achieving the same access-control shape, worth keeping distinct rather than merged; (2) Scoring Model, a named feature on the Capella page, is entirely absent from this page's feature table (see notable_absence); (3) this server/ page documents a Synonym Sources row with five distinct linked sub-pages (create-synonym-collection-docs, add-synonym-source, add-synonym-source-quick, synonyms-search, synonyms-search-quick) that the Capella extraction does not mention at all, though search:synonym-source itself is already a shared cross-product concept from cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json; (4) despite these differences, search:doc-filter's version:server-8-0 gate is confirmed with near-identical wording on both sides - a genuine point of continued agreement inside an otherwise diverged pair.
